definitions.full: H5268. Nisrok נִסְרֹךְ proper name, of a divinity Assyrian god, worshipped by Sennacherib , 2Kin 19:37 = Isa 37:38 ; ᵐ5 Εσδραχ , A Εσθραχ , ᵐ5 L Ασραχ ( Κ ); ᵐ5 Νασαραχ , א Ασαρακ , A Ασαραχ (Isaiah); Jos Ant. x. 1 , 5 Αρασκη ; no such god in cuneiform inscriptions; see views in Meinh Jesaiaerzählungen (1898) on the passage ; corrupt form of Nusku (= נסוך ) according to Hal Jas. xiii (1879), 387 = Mél. de. Crit. 177 Muss-Arn JBL xi.1 (1892), 86 ; Hebraica. vii. 89 R. 17; Nusku is a solar diety, compare Jastr Rel. Bab. 220 f . נֹעָה נֵעָה, see נוע .

occurrences.englishText: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.
